testcase.name: an origin waypoint's designation persists and survives renaming it
saving a waypoint with the same id replaces it rather than duplicating it
waypoints dropped while a track recorded come back for that track, oldest first, and no others
a saved waypoint comes back with every field intact
deleting a waypoint removes it, and a delete of a missing id is not a failure
detaching from a track nulls the link on its waypoints only and keeps every row
